title: Motely Filter
description: A Motely seed filter: the keys, enums and nesting the loader binds.
$comment: Generated from the engine's filter loader by `dotnet run --project Motely.CLI -- schema`. Do not edit: change the clause classes in Motely/Filters, then run the command.

id.description: The filter's identifier, for tools that store filters.

description.description: What the filter looks for, in the author's words.

dateCreated.description: When the filter was written. Metadata: the search never reads it.

deck.description: The deck every seed is played with. Red when not written.

stake.description: The stake every seed is played at. White when not written.

seeds.description: Seeds kept with the filter, for replaying it.

cutoff.description: A fixed score floor: only seeds that score at least this are reported. Without it the host chooses the cutoff.

must.description: Clauses a seed has to match.

should.description: Clauses that score a seed. A seed that matches none still passes.

mustNot.description: Clauses a seed has to not match.

legendaryJokerSourceConfig.description: Which packs a legendary joker clause opens Souls from. Written, it replaces the clause's default sources as a whole.

arcanaPacks.description: Pack offers to read on the Arcana pack path only.

boosterPacks.description: Pack offers where The Soul counts from either an Arcana or a Spectral pack. Not read for slots when arcanaPacks or spectralPacks is written.

requireMegaPack.description: When true, only Mega packs count.

spectralPacks.description: Pack offers to read on the Spectral pack path only.

tagPacks.description: Charm Tag Mega Arcana packs, opened at blind select before the ante's shop: 0 is the small blind's tag, 1 the big blind's.

jokerSourceConfig.description: Where a joker clause looks. Written, it replaces the clause's default sources as a whole.

allShopJokers.description: Rolls of the shop's joker stream across rarities.

uncommonTag.description: Rolls of the Uncommon Tag's joker stream.
